henry hickson
The Hive2026

The core of my recently completed PhD, the Hive is a collective knowledge architecture for hybrid robot swarms. By letting robots share information through a cloud-based Hive, we see measurable improvements in performance, transparency and network efficiency.

PhD thesis Paper: Back to Bee-sics (ALIFE 2025) Paper: Less is More (IEEE ACSOS 2025)
Collective transport

Coordinating multiple, decentralised robots to collectively find, lift and move an object. This is completed without any central control, using local communication only.

DOTS-in-a-box2023

Working with the BRL swarm team to program up some demos for a portable version of our DOTS robot system. This entire system folds down into a portable suitcase. I built this demo to include obstacle avoidance with multiple robots moving between waypoints without crashing, despite the small space.

BlimpleBee2021

A helium-assisted drone for indoor inspection and monitoring of complex 3D spaces. Driven by the vertical farming sector, this project successfully designed, built and tested one of the smallest autonomous blimps of its kind.

Paper: BlimpleBee (TAROS 2024)
Fortitude2015

An autonomous surface vessel designed for crossing oceans. 3m, self-righting, internal power, twin drive, custom hull design with payload space for environmental monitoring.
